summary.intent: Execute all 5 plans in Phase 50 (IPFS/IPNS Data-Integrity Fixes) of the CipherBox project using wave-based parallel worktree execution via the GSD manager workflow.
summary.outcome: All 5 plans executed and merged across 2 waves with post-merge gates passing (build/typecheck clean, 93/93 targeted tests green). Code review was spawned at the end and found 2 blockers in Phase 50's own new code (50-03 regressions) — session ends before those are resolved.

repo: Worktrees share node_modules via pnpm workspace root — any worktree running `pnpm api:generate` or `pnpm install` leaks regenerated/modified files into the orchestrator's main checkout working tree
Husky generates untracked `.husky/_/*` hook stubs whenever pnpm install/generate runs in a worktree — these block cleanup-wave's dirty-tree check

The cleanup-wave helper's `merge_failed` is opaque and can mean: (a) dirty working tree blocks git merge, or (b) the helper's internal merge commit was blocked by lint-staged timing out on 131 api-client files via pre-commit hook
GSD dep parsing fails on strings like 'Phase 49 (v1.1 baseline)' — it creates a phantom phase '1.1' and marks deps unsatisfied; the actual dependency was complete
GSD `gsd_run query commit` (tracking updates) reports `commit_failed` false-negatives — the commits actually succeed and are confirmed via `git log`
The api-client regen (orval) produces 132 files including `openapi.json`; all must be staged together for the pre-commit `check-api-client.sh` hook to pass
IpfsModule → VaultModule has a circular import — extraction is deferred with an explicit cycle-reason comment in all three module files (IpfsModule, PendingUnpinModule, VaultModule)
Phase execution uses baseref-head (fork off current HEAD, not main) so PLAN.md files written during the plan phase are available in worktree executors without extra setup

code.finding: Advisory lock hash changed from `pg_advisory_xact_lock(abs(hashtext($1)::bigint))` to `pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext($1)::bigint)` — abs() caused INT_MIN overflow since hashtext returns signed int4
Added refcount guard: skips physical unpin during drain when CID is re-pinned (WR-03 fix); guard reads live refcount before issuing Kubo unpin call
New `collectSubtreeIpnsNamesAsync` replaces synchronous version — performs on-demand fetch+decrypt for unloaded folders; 4 deletion call-sites updated to async callers
Upload compensation catch block now calls `ipfsProvider.unpinFile(result.cid)` directly (bypassing `guardedUnpin`) to ensure physical Kubo pin removal even when no `pinned_cids` row exists (WR-02)
UnpinDto.cid now enforces `@MaxLength(255)` and `@Matches` regex for CIDv0/CIDv1 format validation (IN-02)
Backfill candidate query now excludes rows newer than 1 hour (`pinned_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'`) to prevent in-flight uploads from being treated as phantom pins (WR-05)

`outboxRowInserted` renamed to `shouldAttemptPhysicalUnpin`; `fileUnpins.inc()` now gated by `rowDeleted` flag so it doesn't fire on no-op paths (IN-06, IN-01); `recordUnpin` deleted entirely — had zero callers (IN-03)

workflow: When cleanup-wave fails with empty stderr and `merge_failed`, the root cause is usually a mid-merge state left by its internal commit failing due to pre-commit hooks — completing the merge manually (`git merge --continue` equivalent after verifying no conflicts) is the correct recovery path
For api-client leak recovery: verify all dirty files in main checkout match the worktree's committed state (hash comparison), then `git checkout --` them before re-attempting merge

Wave 2 key-link validation can produce false failures when the link references the current wave's own deliverable file — parser treats the artifact description as a literal file path; confirm the source file exists independently
Running `pnpm --filter apps/api run test --testPathPattern` is faster and safer than full parallel monorepo test runs for post-merge gate validation; full parallel suites risk RAM starvation
TDD gate verification requires distinct RED commit (`test(N-NN): ...`) before GREEN commit (`fix/feat(N-NN): ...`) per plan — the commit message prefix convention is the machine-readable signal

friction: cleanup-wave helper fails opaquely (`merge_failed`, empty stderr) when its internal commit is blocked by pre-commit hooks (lint-staged on 131 api-client files) — required manual merge completion as recovery

pnpm api:generate leaks regenerated api-client files (132 files) from worktrees into the orchestrator main checkout — detected only when the next worktree merge was attempted and git refused to overwrite them
Husky `.husky/_/*` untracked stubs in worktrees (generated by pnpm install) blocked cleanup-wave's dirty-tree check, requiring manual cleanup before retry
GSD dep string parsing failed on 'Phase 49 (v1.1 baseline)' — created phantom phase '1.1', incorrectly marked Phase 50 as blocked despite all real deps being satisfied
GSD `gsd_run query commit` reports `commit_failed` false-negatives consistently — requires `git log` verification after every tracking commit to confirm success
Bash pipe masked exit codes in the initial typecheck run — required a separate clean-exit-code capture pass
cleanup-wave removed 50-01/50-02 worktrees in the first pass but left 50-05/50-03 in a stalled state, requiring manual merge completion for each remaining worktree
